title: Charge Dispute and Credit Authority Limits for the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
For the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), these limits fix how long a patient has to dispute a charge, how long the account is held while billing reviews it, how quickly billing answers, how many disputes one account accepts, and how large a charge-line credit a patient financial services representative may post without coding review.

## Limits that are the same for every patient class

- **Dispute filing window**: 180 calendar days after the posting date of the first statement that listed the disputed charge.
- **Disputes per account**: 2 charge disputes accepted per encounter.
- **Duplicate lines**: a line duplicating another line's chargemaster code, service date and units is credited without coding review (yes, for every patient class).

## Limits by patient class

| Patient class | Dispute hold (calendar days) | Dispute response (business days) | Representative credit authority (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Outpatient Clinic Visit Account | 30 | 10 | 150.00 |
| Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account | 30 | 10 | 250.00 |
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | 30 | 10 | 250.00 |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 45 | 15 | 500.00 |
| Outpatient Surgery Account | 45 | 15 | 750.00 |
| Observation Stay Account | 60 | 20 | 750.00 |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 60 | 20 | 1000.00 |

The dispute hold is the billing hold granted while a charge dispute is reviewed; the dispute response is counted in business days after the dispute is logged; the credit authority is the largest charge-line credit a representative may post without coding review.

## Authority at the boundary (hypothetical credits)

| Account | Credit | Within representative authority |
|---|---|---|
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 500.00 | yes |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 500.01 | no |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 1000.00 | yes |
